title: Pyne Pod 2in1 Cherry Ice Prefilled Vape Pods - Pod Salt Edition
description: This Cherry Ice Pod Pack for the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 Kit delivers a vivid and refreshing vape that contrasts bold fruit with clean coolness. The deep, ruby-rich Cherry flavour offers jammy sweetness with a hint of tartness, while a brisk Ice layer cuts through with a crisp finish. It’s a distinctive, well-rounded profile that keeps things sharp and satisfying throughout. Each 2ml pod is prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and designed exclusively for the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 device. The pods attach magnetically and are compatible with the device’s twist-to-switch mouthpiece, letting you enjoy different flavours throughout the day. This twin pack of Cherry Ice pods is ideal for pairing with fruit, menthol, or beverage-inspired blends in the full Pyne Pod range.
